metrics.formula: Within each verified circuit configuration, select the minimum explicitly valid Sprint lap duration and count tied record ownership once per entity.
metrics.scope: Formula 1 World Championship Sprint sessions only through 2026-07-26; Grand Prix qualifying and race laps are excluded
metrics.blockingReason: No openly licensed complete or non-empty partial Sprint fastest-lap corpus with explicit driver, constructor, lap time and lap number fields was found; the available official detailed timing materials impose reuse restrictions.

metrics.label: Track Records
metrics.definition: Ranks entities by the number of verified circuit-configuration records they hold from valid qualifying and Grand Prix race fastest laps through the cut-off. Only verified circuit configurations are included.
metrics.formula: For each verified circuit configuration, select the minimum lap duration from valid qualifying and Grand Prix race fastest laps; credit each tied holder once, then count owned configurations per entity.
metrics.scope: Formula 1 World Championship qualifying and race laps with verified circuit configuration and valid duration through 2026-07-26; Sprint sessions are excluded

target.coverageDescription: Only verified circuit configurations are included.
